data.body:
RCA (Phase 1 — fast path, confirmed).

Mechanism (defect): src/rebar/llm/plan_review/det_operator_attested.py:168 operator_evidence_issues() emits P6 advisory coaching whose fix instruction reads '...is not tagged [operator-attested]; prefix the checkbox text with [operator-attested] so the completion verifier accepts a recorded attestation...'. It prescribes the LEGACY alias [operator-attested] as the tag authors should add.

Authoritative intended-behavior violated: ADR 0101 (docs/adr/0101-non-codebase-acceptance-criterion-tag.md) line 35 ('The canonical acceptance-criterion tag is [non-codebase]') and line 49 ('the matcher accepts either spelling; author-facing guidance teaches only [non-codebase]'). The alias is retained but deliberately UNDOCUMENTED. This coaching is author-facing guidance, so it must teach [non-codebase], not the alias. Confirmed reproduced: calling operator_evidence_issues on an untagged operational AC returns a string containing '[operator-attested]' and zero '[non-codebase]'.

Runtime confirmation: python -c import shows the emitted string prescribes '[operator-attested]'.

Attribution (unmet obligation, date-test): the coaching string was introduced by a67f85f3c542 (2026-07-18, R2 eval detector) and was correct-at-the-time. ADR 0101 landed 2026-08-20 (d6841983c675), creating the obligation to teach only [non-codebase]. The migration that enacted it — story 'S6 — cut close-guard and remediation strings over to [non-codebase]' (2b15-9d27-90b1-4e7a, unbeatable-unlit-gadwall) — enumerated author-facing remediation strings in txn.py and completion_reconcile.py but OMITTED this P6 plan-review coaching string. The implicated line predates the transition (a67f85 << ADR 0101), so per the fix-site!=cause-site rule the origin is the migration story whose scope should have covered this consumer, not the R2 commit. caused_by -> 2b15-9d27-90b1-4e7a; close class plan_defect (incomplete migration scope).

Scope: local, behavior-preserving. Dual-token matcher _OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE and internal Python identifiers unchanged (ADR 0101 compat). Caller-dependency gate: only consumer det_advisory.py:197 surfaces the string verbatim as advisory text — no dependency on the alias spelling; only-incidental → clear.

Proceeding to Phase 2 (RED->GREEN).
